items.value: Users are engineering and growth teams at scaling startups.
Buyers are technical and product executives who need consistency, security, and a review process they can defend.
Auth0 translates its docs. Sierra translates marketing and sales material. Ramp translates its core dashboard.
Legacy translation management systems bill per seat and cover only part of the stack.
